formula_text: charged_amount_excluding_tax + shipping_amount - gross_commission = settled_amount for forward rows; source waterfall observed forward net settled 121,342 and payout rate 85.2%.
name: Target Plus forward payout waterfall
sign_convention: Use transaction_type/internal_txn_type context; do not mix forward, reverse, and reverse charge unless netting is intended.
usage_notes: Forward product rows; use charged_amount_excluding_tax for multi-quantity order value.

formula_text: reverse settled impact = return refund amount minus/plus commission reversal per settlement sign; source shows net return settlement -9,185.
name: Target Plus return refund netting
sign_convention: Use transaction_type/internal_txn_type context; do not mix forward, reverse, and reverse charge unless netting is intended.
usage_notes: Reverse rows only; gross_commission may reverse as a credit to seller.

formula_text: reverse charge rows use transaction_type = reverse charge and internal_txn_type = others; gross_commission_percentage = 0; settled_amount is a negative tax adjustment while total_tax remains 0.
name: Target Plus reverse-charge tax adjustment
sign_convention: Use transaction_type/internal_txn_type context; do not mix forward, reverse, and reverse charge unless netting is intended.
usage_notes: Not a customer return; filter reverse charge separately from transaction_type=reverse.
